mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Shyvana has transformed into a powerful dragon. While Shyvana has Fury, her abilities gain additional area of effect properties and <keywordMajor>Dragon Form's</keywordMajor> defensive bonuses are doubled.
Shyvana's next attack will strike twice.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana's basic attacks enhance her abilities.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shyvana's basic attacks enhance her abilities.

Twin Bite: Reduces the cooldown by @TwinBite_CDR_Reduction@ seconds.
Burnout: Extends the duration by @Burnout_Duration_Increase@ second up to @Burnout_Duration_MaxIncrease@ additional seconds.
Flame Breath: Deals @Flamebreath_Damage_Percent*100@% of the ability's magic damage to debuffed targets.
Dragon's Descent: Attacks generate @Ult_Attack_Rage_Generation@ Fury and Shyvana gains @Ult_Passive_Rage_Generation@ Fury every @Ult_Passive_Rage_Generation_Tick@ seconds while in human form.
Armor is reduced and attacks from Shyvana will reignite the cinders, dealing additional magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals damage to all enemies it encounters and leaves cinders on the target marking them for 4 seconds. Basic attacks on marked targets deal a percentage of their maximum health as damage on-hit. Dragon Form: Flame Breath engulfs all units in a cone in front of her.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals @Damage@ magic damage to targets hit, debuffing them and reducing their Armor by @ArmorShred*100@% for @DebuffDuration@ seconds. Basic attacks to debuffed targets deal @BonusDamage@ magic damage On-Hit.

Dragon Form: Flame Breath fires in a cone in front of her.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite by 0.5 seconds. Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front Shyvana.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack, dealing @Calc_Bonus_Damage@ physical damage on the second attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite by @Cooldown_Reduction@ seconds.

Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front of Shyvana.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take damage and are knocked toward her target location. Shyvana passively gains Armor and Magic Resistance. Defensive bonuses are doubled in Dragon Form.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Active: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take @Damage@ magic damage and are knocked toward her target location.

Passive: Shyvana reinforces her scales, increasing her Armor and Magic Resist by @SeasonOne_ArmorMRGain@. Defensive bonuses are doubled in Dragon Form.

While in Dragon Form Shyvana's abilities have additional effects.

Shyvana's Movement Speed is increased and nearby enemies take damage over time.

Dragon Form: Shyvana leaves a path of fire behind, dealing damage to enemies that stand in it.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana surrounds herself in fire, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies and moving faster for 3 seconds. The movement speed reduces over the duration of the spell. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout. Dragon Form: Burnout scorches the ground beneath it, enemies on the scorched earth continue to take damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shyvana deals @Damage@ magic damage per second to nearby enemies and moves @BaseMoveSpeed*100@% faster for @MoveSpeedDuration@ seconds. Shyvana's Move Speed bonus is reduced over time. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout by @DurationIncreasePerHit@ second to a maximum of @MaxDurationIncrease@ seconds.

Dragon Form: Burnout scorches the earth, continuing to damage enemies that stand on it.
